semantics.function: pos = min({i in 0..3 : in[i] == 1}) when any bit is set; otherwise pos = 0
semantics.priority: bit 0 highest, then bit 1, bit 2, bit 3
semantics.timing: pure combinational; output follows current input after combinational settling, no clock-cycle latency

numeric.input: unsigned four-bit vector; all 16 binary patterns legal
numeric.arithmetic: index selection only; no arithmetic overflow, rounding, truncation, or saturation

verification.oracle: independent truth table for input values 0..15: [0,0,1,0,2,0,1,0,3,0,1,0,2,0,1,0]
verification.coverage: all 16 inputs and all 256 ordered input transitions, including zero, one-hot, and multi-hot values
verification.comparison: case inequality after settling; mismatch fatal
verification.tool: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; matching vvp
verification.timeout: finite shell timeout for each compile and simulation; simulation watchdog

specification_ambiguities: Behavior for X or Z input bits is unspecified; verification covers binary inputs only.
